title: Jamaican Pork Roast Casserole
description: A flavorful and hearty casserole made with roasted pork and Jamaican spices. Perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Season the pork roast with salt, pepper, and Jamaican jerk seasoning.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the pork roast until browned on all sides.
Transfer the pork roast to a large casserole dish. Add chopped onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender.
Add diced tomatoes, brown rice, and shredded cheddar cheese to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Pour the rice mixture over the pork roast in the casserole dish.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the pork roast is cooked through and the rice is tender.
Let the casserole rest for 10 minutes before serving.
